tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this chapter (except sections 5107(e), 5108(g)(2), 5113, 5115, 5116, and 5119)—

tree.heading: Hazardous Materials Emergency Preparedness Fund.—
tree.text: From the Hazardous Materials Preparedness Fund established under section 5116(h), the Secretary may expend, for each of fiscal years 2022 through 2026—

children.text: $625,000 to publish and distribute the Emergency Response Guidebook under section 5116(h)(3); and

tree.heading: Hazardous Materials Training Grants.—
tree.text: From the Hazardous Materials Emergency Preparedness Fund established pursuant to section 5116(h), the Secretary may expend $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2022 through 2026 to carry out section 5107(e).

tree.heading: Community Safety Grants.—
tree.text: Of the amounts made available under subsection (a) to carry out this chapter, the Secretary shall withhold $4,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2022 through 2026 to carry out section 5107(i).

children.heading: Expenses.—
children.text: In addition to amounts otherwise made available to carry out this chapter, the Secretary may credit amounts received from a State, Indian tribe, or other public authority or private entity for expenses the Secretary incurs in providing training to the State, Indian tribe, authority or entity.

children.heading: Availability of amounts.—
children.text: Amounts made available under this section shall remain available until expended.
